<thought>Chlorine shows a characteristic M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak, matching the 35Cl/37Cl natural abundance ratio. The noticeable M+1 peak (~10 % of base) aligns with the expected 13C contribution from several carbons, confirming carbon’s presence. No other element shows a distinctive isotopic pattern in the data.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
